newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Hong Kong will remain full APEC member after 1997.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong will remain full APEC member after 1997.

text.p: Hong Kong will remain a full member of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum after the territory reverts to China next year, Hong Kong and Chinese officials stressed on Saturday.

"Hong Kong will remain a full and equal member of APEC after July 1997 under the name China-Hong Kong," Hong Kong's secretary of trade and industry, Denise Yue, told a questioner at an APEC ministerial news conference.
Chinese Foreign Minister Qian Qichen also referred to the British colony's status after it reverts to Beijing's rule at midnight on June 30 next year.
"Hong Kong will be a special region of China, but its status in APEC will not change," he said.

The Hong Kong and Chinese delegations were seated next to each other during the press conference, which marked the end of the two-day annual meeting of foreign and trade ministers and officials from the 18 APEC members before their leaders hold their fourth annual summit in nearby Subic Bay on Monday.
